newsitem.title: USA: US railroad group forms CSX safety inspection team.
newsitem.headline: US railroad group forms CSX safety inspection team.

text.p: The Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) on Monday formed a team to review operational and safety issues on CSX Transportation railroad following a number of recent incidents.

The team will inspect and review all operational practices on CSX railroad property to determine whether the highest levels of safety are performed and maintained throughout the system, the FRA said in a statement.
"Given recent incidents at CSX, we believe an intense examination of the railroad's practices is warranted at this time," said FRA administrator Jolene Molitoris.
Members of the team include inspectors and specialists in the signal, dispatch, operating practices, and hazardous materials disciplines within the FRA.

Recent mishaps include a 10-car freight train derailment on July 8 near Washington, in which an Amtrak passenger train was sideswiped, and a rear-end collision between two CSX freight trains in West Virginia on June 7.
